items.title: Jackie McLean — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I used to let him sit in with me when he first was coming to New York... He would always come to my gig. He knew he could sit in, play with me.

ctx.x: Yeah, I liked him. I respect him and appreciate him more now than I did when I was coming up. For that sound, I like Lee Konitz much more. But I liked Paul Desmond. He was a good saxophone . . .
You mean that sound like that light, almost airy kind of sound?
